page.layout: Two-column chronological table on one printed page: a left column of entries with year numbers and italic text, and a narrower column to the right of it, cut off at its top edge. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. No text below the table.; Narrow strip of a page: a column of printed numbers at the right of a vertical rule, with a second column of short references at the left in the margin. No running text.; One page of text in a table-like chronology: a right-hand column of entries with numbers in a narrow column beside it (right of the entries), and below it a block of lines with a number column at left and a running paragraph at the foot; a note "RE." at lower right. Scan is cut off at left and top.

page.notes: The right-hand column is only partly visible at the top of the image, so its entries stop after the fragment given. Some entry text in the left column, such as "Latinꝰ" and "Faunꝰ", has a superscript mark that is hard to read; the forms given are the nearest reading. Left-margin marginal references: "40." beside 4042, "30." and "40." beside 4063 and 4110 rows, "38." and "45." beside 4131 area, "40." at the bottom. The numbers in the right column are partly worn; 4054 and 4055 and 4063 are doubtful readings. Dark ink blotches lie over the lower half of the strip and may hide characters. Scan is cut off at left and top; the number column at the left of the lower block is partly lost. Marginal numbers (33, 12, 1, 8, 37, 21) stand in the right margin beside the first entries and are printed as side numbers. Lower block: the first number column reads 4248, 4268, 4318, 4360, 4380 and the second is partly unreadable.
